prompts.frame: Create a production-ready raster UI FRAME for an original paper-and-bamboo creature game boss warning. One single wide horizontal frame, approximately 3:1 aspect, transparent RGBA outside. Center area is a nearly black charcoal paper panel, subtle worn fibrous paper texture, completely empty and calm to receive live game text. Center 65 percent must stay empty. Straight stretchable top and bottom center edges, consistent band thickness. Strong angular folded dark paper and aged iron corners, vermilion red painted outlines and small warm brass rivets, restrained ember red edge glow. Two thin yellow ochre and charcoal diagonal hazard stripe strips along top and bottom, mostly confined to outer border, original crafted adventure game art, clean dark ink outlines and cel shaded planes. Fine nicks and scratches only at edges, no noisy background. Distinct sturdy left and right caps, safely stretchable blank middle, designed for nine-slice UI use. Premium illustrated game asset, dangerous but consistent with handmade paper, bamboo and reclaimed pipe materials. Front-on orthographic flat UI, symmetrical silhouette, no perspective. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO skull, NO character, NO symbols, NO scene, NO mockup. Frame fills 92 percent of image width with transparent outer padding, all corners fully visible.
prompts.crest: Create a production UI boss crest portrait for this exact approved Lacertubo creature. The provided image is the IDENTITY REFERENCE. Preserve the teal and orange folded paper reptile, cream muzzle, bamboo joints and dorsal triangular sail; do NOT redesign into a red demon or dragon, no metal skin, no skull. Compose a close head and shoulder portrait of the same character facing left, fierce narrow eyes, framed in a dark charcoal diamond medallion built from folded black paper and short reclaimed iron pipe corners, aged brass ties, thin vermilion red outline and small red ember marks. The portrait should be recognizable at 72px. Creature head can break the upper-left medallion edge slightly, silhouette contained safely with transparent padding. Original adventure game illustration, crisp dark ink outlines, simple cel shading, restrained fiber texture on frame only. Square asset, one single medallion centered, transparent RGBA background. NO text, letters, numerals, health bar, UI mockup or background scene. This is an emblem insert for a dangerous boss health HUD. Do not animate or provide multiple frames.

normalization: Crop to alpha bounds and proportional Lanczos reduction; frame 1536×499, crest 512×514
animation: Static PNG art animated in DOM/CSS, no generated sprite animation
identity: Approved teal/orange paper reptile, cream muzzle, bamboo/pipe joints and triangular dorsal sail retained
